info.name: DigiMandal - Issues API
info.description:
Complete Mandal-scoped issue workflow.

SETUP: Set collection variables baseUrl and token (JWT without Bearer prefix). For admin actions set adminToken. Select mandalId from My active Mandals; selectedMemberId is the membership ID from Active members. Fill issue form variables and dates. Select local files in each multipart upload request. Generated IDs and retry keys are saved in collection variables. Do not create environment variables with the same names: environment values override captured collection variables.

RUN: Execute folders in order manually. Optional authentication can be skipped if tokens are supplied. Do not run the entire collection unattended: uploads need file selection and the last folder contains alternative deletion/archive operations. Reuse the same publication/resolution key and body for retries. Clear publicationKey/resolutionKey when starting a new issue flow; upload fresh images.

SECURITY: All issue routes require active membership. Cross-Mandal resources return 404; members cannot grant themselves approver roles. Tokens/passwords are intentionally blank. No requests were sent when generating this collection.

item.name: 01 - Authentication (optional)
item.description: Paste existing tokens into collection variables, or use these password-login requests for already registered users. Credentials remain blank in this export.

item.name: 03 - Raise issue and preview
item.description: Choose a local photo in Body > form-data. Fill issueTitle, issueDescription, issueLocation and occurrenceDate (YYYY-MM-DD). Publication key is generated once and reused for retries. Clear publicationKey and upload a NEW image before creating a separate issue.
